title: Critical Code Studies Workbench, Classic (pre-bench-kit)
description: The pre-bench-kit Critical Code Studies Workbench. A browser-based IDE for close reading of software as cultural artefact: three modes of engagement (Analyze, Learn, Create), six typed line-anchored annotations (Observation, Question, Metaphor, Pattern, Context, Critique), a browser-direct AI co-reader across seven providers with keys the user holds, drift-aware name-based merge of .ccs project files between collaborators, and a built-in corpus of recoverable historical software (FLOW-MATIC 1958, IPL-V 1958, Spacewar! 1962, ELIZA 1965 with thirty scholarly annotations, Apollo 11 Comanche055 1969). Preserved as a scholarly artefact in its own right; active development has moved to the bench-kit-based successor, CCSbench, at https://github.com/Computational-Hermeneutics/CCSbench.
